programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Valet på parceremonin skapar splittring på hotellet. Det har blivit dags för superhjältarna att ta plats i paradiset, men mörka krafter hotar, och oron blir stor när tjejerna mystiskt försvinner.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Superskurken gör allt för att vara neutral trots att motiven kraftigt ifrågasätts. Heta känslor, kraftig paranoia och svidande lärdomar är ledorden för kvällens superhjältefest.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: En PH-Legend checkar in i kampen mot superskurkens planer – men vem spelar på vilken sida egentligen? Säsongens första pandoras ask väntar och skurkaktiga planer hotar att förstöra stämningen totalt!

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Paradise Hotel slår återigen upp portarna, och den här säsongen checkar 14 gäster in – redan första dagen. Clean girls ställs mot Mean girls och frågan är – vad föredrar egentligen killarna?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Fyra Mean girls har checkat in och minst sagt rört om i grytan. Kampen om killarna är stenhård och stämningen förvärras ytterligare när en tjej ska röstas ut – redan innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel
programme.desc: Vilka tvingas checka ut från Paradise Hotel redan första veckan och vilka får fortsätta spela spelet i jakten på en halv miljon kronor? Det har blivit dags för säsongens första parceremoni!

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2512
programme.desc: 25-åriga Jerry från Stockholm är hyrbilsberoende och har det senaste året hyrt lyxbilar för över 85 000 kronor. Utöver det har han åkt taxi för nästan 35 000 kronor och en hel del pengar har gått till bensin.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2809
programme.desc: 2017 dog Evas man och livet rasade. Hennes man hade skött all deras ekonomi och efter hans död uppdagades det att de hade skulder. Eva tog lån för att hanka sig fram och nu tickar räntorna snabbt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan
programme.desc: I knappt fem år fick Lovisa och Jonas behålla sin multisjuka dotter My. De ständiga sjukhusbesöken och den förlamande sorgen efter hennes bortgång har nu lett till att Lovisas ekonomi raserats.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2508
programme.desc: 23-åriga Max från Borås är biltokig och har trots sina unga år redan hunnit äga inte mindre än 14 bilar. Men det är inte bara bilarna som kostat pengar, det senaste året har han dragit på sig hela 44 p-böter.

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2504
programme.desc: Therese, 34 år, från Svalöv skyller gärna sina skulder på yttre omständigheter. Det senaste året har hon bränt 123 616 kronor på Ullared, cigaretter, godis och sina 13 marsvin.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 107
programme.desc: 16-åriga Madde har äntligen blivit mamma. Mileah har kommit till världen och vid en första anblick har allting gått bra.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 108
programme.desc: Madde och Isaacs bebis tillbringar sina första dagar i livet på sjukhuset. Hon fick andningssvårigheter efter förlossningen på grund av fostervatten i lungorna.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 109
programme.desc: Natalies kennel har blivit granskad av SKK och nu måste hon vidta en rad åtgärder. Om hon inte gör det så kommer de stänga ner kenneln innan veckan är slut. Men hon har ett tugnt jobb framför sig.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 501
programme.desc: I säsongspremiären av Unga mammor får du återigen träffa Natalie som nu flyttat till ny gård utanför Herrljunga med Richard och sina tre barn. Fayme som var med i säsong 3 kommer tillbaka.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 502
programme.desc: 23-åriga Ellinor är ny för säsongen och bor tillsammans med sin man Jimmy utanför Stockholm. De har precis fått en son som de ska namnge men har svårt att bestämma sig för namn.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 503
programme.desc: Luma tar hem en inredare för att få ordning på uterummet. Niffi ska åka och handla med sina tvillingar och Sonia ska gå till BVC med sin äldsta dotter Daisy.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 504
programme.desc: Ellinor ska in till stan med sin son Aaron för att spela in en babypodd, och det blir första gången hon jobbar med honom som sällskap. Hur ska det gå?

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: Luma tar med sina tre barn för att köpa pizza. Barnen låser in sig i bilen och Luma vet inte hur hon ska lösa det. Sonia och Liam tar barnen på utflykt för att lära dem att åka skateboard.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 506
programme.desc: Fayme ska måla staketet på tomten tillsammans med hela familjen, men hur ska det gå med tre små barn?

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 507
programme.desc: Det är dags för Fayme att ta med barnen till leklandet. Natalie åker och köper tapeter till Ronjas nya rum och Jonatan ska lära Niffi att laga mat.

programme.title: Unga Mammor: Avsnitt 508
programme.desc: Ellinor, Jimmy och deras son Aaron ska på par middag hos Ellinors väninna Kissie som är lite pedant i sitt hem.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1204
programme.desc: Dennis är utanför Sälen där en 1,5-åring lekt med bilnycklarna och råkat låsa in sig själv i bilen. Mörkret har börjat falla på E12 utanför Umeå där Simon och Jörgen bärgar ett släp som väger 27 ton.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1205
programme.desc: Kent och Robin är i en ökänd kurva utanför Åre där det inträffat en trafikolycka. Den ena bilen har skadats kraftigt, något som gör bärgningen utmanande.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1206
programme.desc: Hogan är vid Högfjällshotellet där en holländsk husbil från tidigt 70-tal kört fast i snön. Han behöver ta det varsamt när ekipaget ska vinschas så inget går sönder.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1207
programme.desc: Stefan och praktikanten Victor är i centrala Örnsköldsvik där en chaufför fastnat och står knepigt. Kent ska försöka bärga en bil som körts utför en brant slänt i samband med en filminspelning.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1208
programme.desc: Kent har fått in ett larm om en våldsam trafikolycka på E14 utanför Åre. I Sälen är det regn och plusgrader, vilket gjort vägarna glashala. Hogan får larm från ett par turister som glidit av vägen.

programme.title: Frusna vägar: Avsnitt 1301
programme.desc: Två nya stationer gör entré i programmet. I Luleå hjälper Emelie vid en seriekrock, Markus i Gällivare får ett utmanande uppdrag, och i Sälen hjälper Dennis och Hogan efter en våldsam krock.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1010
programme.desc: I säsongens sista avsnitt laddar Sofie Prydz för en fin middagsbjudning. Hon får hjälp av väninnan och designern Rebecca Stella att hitta en perfekt och något avslöjande klänning.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1101
programme.desc: Isabel Adrian gör comeback den här säsongen och nu förbereder hon för dottern Winter Roses födelsedag med ett tårtbattle mot maken Steve Angello.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1102
programme.desc: Jennifer Åkerman gör entré och visar en lite annorlunda livsstil än vi är vana att se. Isabel Adrian smider planer för fruträffen men hennes personliga inbjudan skapar många frågetecken.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1103
programme.desc: Isabel Adrian och Elena Belle testar en av de senaste Hollywoodtrenderna – med droppställning och kanyl. Jennifer Åkerman plåtas till en reklamkampanj för sin mammas klädmärke.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1104
programme.desc: Det har äntligen blivit dags för den stora fruträffen . Fruarna ska tillbringa ett dygn i avkopplande miljö ägna sig åt tillitsövningar för att se om det kan hjälpa till att släppa gammalt groll.

programme.title: Svenska Hollywoodfruar: Avsnitt 1105
programme.desc: Den stora fruträffen är i full gång men det tar inte lång tid innan det som skulle bli en trevlig kväll spårar ur. Gunilla Persson bestämmer sig för att konfrontera Isabel Adrian.

programme.title: Svenska Truckers
programme.desc: AnaMaria och Lorens arbetar båda som sopchaufförer, men har helt olika inställningar till sina jobb. AnaMaria blir lätt äcklad av råttor och lukter, medan Lorens enligt egen utsago “älskar sopor”.

programme.title: Svenska Truckers
programme.desc: En nykär Maja beger sig ut på snäva landsvägar för att transportera en enorm skogsmaskin, och problem uppstår. Det slår bokstavligen gnistor från Andreas ekipage när han kör iväg med en transformator.

programme.title: Svenska Truckers
programme.desc: Spike har en hel del lossningar i Stockholm och för att klara körtiden behöver han ha ett högt tempo. En annalkande storm och en felleverans riskerar att sabotera hela Mickes arbetsdag.

programme.title: Svenska Truckers
programme.desc: Lorens och hans kollega Jesper försöker slå rekord i att snabbast göra klart sin soprunda, men när sopbilen börjar krångla tappar de tempot rejält. Isak lever drömlivet i sin lastbil ute på vägarna.

programme.title: Svenska Truckers
programme.desc: För tolfte säsongen får vi följa med våra svenska truckers och deras äventyr ute på vägarna. Vi får möta den nya deltagaren Philip, som på sin resa mot Arlanda blir stoppad av lagens långa arm.

programme.title: Högspänning: Avsnitt 104
programme.desc: Ett snötäckt träd hänger över en ledning och Niclas och Simon har fått i uppdrag att åtgärda problemet I Blaiken jobbar Linus och Jonas för att laga ett blad i Vindkraftverket, 100 meter ovanför marken.

programme.title: Högspänning: Avsnitt 105
programme.desc: Conny och Omid tar hjälp av en helikopter för att få en ny elledning på plats, men både väder och vind ställer till det rejält. I Stockholm tvingas David och Alexander jobba sent i mörker och kyla.

programme.title: Högspänning: Avsnitt 106
programme.desc: Blöt tung snö har gjort flera hushåll strömlösa, enda sättet för Anton och Anders att lösa problemet är att spränga bort trädet. Niclas och Simon ska utföra ett rutinarbete som inte alls går som planerat.

programme.title: Högspänning: Avsnitt 107
programme.desc: På Sveriges största vindkraftspark till havs, har Clayton och Stefan fått ett brådskande larm där plötsligt något går fel, en mil från fastlandet.

programme.title: Högspänning: Avsnitt 108
programme.desc: Utanför Arjeplog lagar Sture och hans brorson Erik gatubelysningen, men den djupa snön ställer till med problem. Niclas och Simon genomför en riktig balansakt när de kämpar för att laga en elledning.

programme.title: Högspänning: Avsnitt 109
programme.desc: Larmet går på ett av vindkraftverken i Lillgrund. Det är mörkt och blåsigt när Stefan och Clayton skyndar sig ut med båten för att fixa problemet. Jonna utbildar sig för att gå med i insatsstyrkan.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 8
programme.desc: Kärleksveckan fortsätter, och nu är det dags för den första vinnaren från Paradise Motel att äntra det "riktiga" hotellet. Gänget välkomnar PH-veteranen Smail tillbaka som hotellets kärleksgud Amor.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 8
programme.desc: Kärleksveckan lider mot sitt slut. Hos vilket par spirar romantiken lite extra, och vem får sitt hjärta krossat? Det är rejält spänd stämning på hotellet inför kvällens parceremoni.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 8
programme.desc: Stopp i lagens namn – tjuv- och polisveckan är här! Gänget vaknar till glädjebeskedet om att alla par fått immunitet, men det dröjer inte länge förrän en tjuv smyger runt och stjäl immuniteterna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 16
programme.desc: Det råder bröllopsfeber på Paradise Hotel och gästerna ska få knyta hymens band. Men först är det traditionsenlig möhippa – där en oväntad gäst dyker upp och får fria till en av tjejerna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 16
programme.desc: Gästerna väcks upp av kyrkklockor efter nattens svensexa. Det är bröllopsdag i paradiset och gåvor ska delas ut till de blivande äkta makarna. Men finns det gåvor till alla par?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 16
programme.desc: Äktenskapsbryterskan har checkat in på hotellet för att röra om i grytan och bröllopsmiddagen blir en jobbig tillställning. Smekmånaden blir inte heller en dans på rosor när en skilsmässa hotar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 17
programme.desc: Gästerna släpper loss ordentligt på skoldiscot och en ny kärlekshistoria verkar vara på väg att blomma ut mellan två av eleverna. Fler prov står på schemat och nya möjligheter för guldstjärnor.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 17
programme.desc: Det är dags för eleverna att grilla varandra i ett klassråd. Konflikter och hemligheter puttrar upp till ytan och sprider nervositet. En åtråvärd immunitet står även på spel inför slutprovet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 17
programme.desc: Skolveckan lider mot sitt slut och en kille står i riskzonen att åka hem, och ett rykte sprids som en löpeld bland deltagarna. Vem, eller vilka, kan inte lita på sin partner i veckans parceremoni?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 5
programme.desc: Skräcken och ångesten sprids som en löpeld bland deltagarna när de tvingas ta på sig skoluniformer och gå tillbaka till skolbänken. För att hålla ordning i klassen så checkar en ny lärarinna in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 5
programme.desc: Ny skoldag och klassens lärare bestämmer att dagens utmaning för eleverna är att förbereda roliga timmen för varandra.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 5
programme.desc: Parceremonidag och spänt läge från start när flera tjejer hänger löst. Deras öde hamnar i deras partners händer då de ska skriva prov i sexualkunskap där veckans sista immunitet delas ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel Sverige, säsong 17

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Killing Zone
programme.desc: In the 1990's the war on drugs was in full swing. The front lines were often America's inner cities where gangs use violence and murder to rule their empires.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Takeover
programme.desc: Two armed bank robbers hit a Seattle bank taking over 150,000 dollars. Before they can escape police confront them and the pair splits up. As authorities search block by block they learn one was a career criminal with a long history of violence.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Perfect Heist

programme.title: The FBI Files: Brotherhood of Hate
programme.desc: In 1984, a tragic murder led agents into the frightening world of domestic terrorism. Law enforcement vowed to dismantle the violent faction that claimed responsibility.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killer Instinct
programme.desc: In the early 1990's, a serial killer stalked lone victims in the dead of night, his hunting ground the suburbs of Washington, D.C., his target, anyone who owned a car.

programme.title: Odd Man Rush
programme.desc: Odd Man Rush är baserad på Bill Keenans bästsäljande självbiografi med samma namn. Filmens Bobby Sanders flyttar från Harvards hockeylag till div. 1 i Sverige, i en deal som inbegriper en tvättmaskin och torktumlare.

programme.title: Couples Vacation
programme.desc: Jack är en tidigare hyllad bästsäljande författare. Författarkarriären och hans äktenskap är i kris och därför åker han och hans fru Amanda till en glampingretreat i jakt på den gnista som skulle kunna få deras kärlek att börja glöda igen.

programme.title: Banana Joe
programme.desc: Westernstjärnan Bud Spencer spelar en godhjärtad men järnnävad bananodlare som bor i en liten djungelby. Ett stort bananföretag vill exploatera byn, och när Joe sätter sig på tvären bestämmer sig företagsledaren – en gangster – att sätta dit honom.

programme.title: Kalla mig Dave
programme.desc: Det är inte för att han är besvärlig, blyg eller klädd i discokläder som Dave Ming Chang sticker ut i New York. Det beror på att han är en utomjording! Närmare bestämt ett utomjordiskt rymdskepp...

programme.title: Boomerang: There U Go
programme.desc: Gänget gör sig klara för Homecoming, vissa med sex i åtanke, och det blir tydligt hur alla har förändrats eller inte efter Simones och Brysons uppbrott.

programme.title: Boomerang: Love Shoulda Brought You Home
programme.desc: Alla berättar sin version av vad som hände när Simone och Bryson gjorde slut, vilket avslöjar vad de tycker om varandra och prövar deras lojalitet.

programme.title: Games People Play: Persons of Interests
programme.desc: Loomis ser Cooper vid en Vipersmatch. Cooper tvingas lämna ifrån sig övervakningsfilmen från bråket mellan Vanessa och Kalinda. Hon erbjuder sig att lämna in den för att behålla jobbet, men får sparken när hon gör det.

programme.title: Games People Play: A Wing and A Prayer
programme.desc: Laila hamnar i en farlig situation. MJ hör rykten om att nån läcker uppgifter om familjen King. Vanessas familj hotas och hon bestämmer att det är dags att agera.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Bitch is Back
programme.desc: Laila gömmer sig, oförmögen att tillbringa natten ensam. Vanessa köper motvilligt en ny telefon till Laila, som snart får veta att Susie Q är död. Vanessa tvingas trösta henne, trots att hon knappt tål henne.

programme.title: Games People Play: The Way You Save
programme.desc: Kareem säger till Marcus att han inte kan leva i hans skugga och ber honom att få bli utköpt. Marcus betalar honom 250 000. Kareem och Quanisha åker till Jamal med en väska med pengar för att få honom att försvinna.

programme.title: Being Mary Jane: Freedom
programme.desc: Mary Jane ser fram emot en ångestfri helg men planerna går i stöpet när Mark ringer och ber henne om hjälp med hans föräldrar som är på besök. Avslöjanden under besöket tvingar Mark att göra en förändring.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Avskedsblickar
programme.desc: Matt hjälper Jeffrey komma ut ur garderoben. Det resulterar i att Jeffrey förflyttas till East Coast och de båda måste ta farväl på riktigt.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Bortsvept
programme.desc: Sydney börjar utpressa Michael med en alkoholhalt i blodet-bluff genom att flytta ihop med honom och säga att hon är hans nya flickvän.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Med den här bojan
programme.desc: När Jo blir gripen för mordet på Reed, försöker hon berätta för en skeptisk polis och åklagaren att hon inte var inblandad i Reeds knarklangning.

programme.title: Melrose Place: Förlovad på annat håll
programme.desc: När Amanda säger att Alisons förlovningsring ser billig ut, letar Alison och Billy efter en äkta diamant. Jo får veta att hon är gravid med Reeds barn.

programme.desc: En misstänksam Matt ger sig ut för att hitta Michael som är på smekmånad med Sydney och väntar på den perfekta stunden att mörda henne.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home Evasion
programme.desc: In 2000, Judy Southern arrived home from work and was shot by a gunman waiting within. Her husband arrived shortly afterwards, called emergency services and drove her to the hospital.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Window Watcher
programme.desc: In 1986, Gary Dale Larson was stabbed to death in his Edmond, Oklahoma home. The killer then sexually assaulted Larson's girlfriend, Janet Haynes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stranger in the Night
programme.desc: In 1991, Dorothy Donovan was murdered in her Dover, Delaware home. When her son stated that she was murdered by a hitchhiker he had picked up, police were skeptical.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Killers
programme.desc: Weeks pass as forensic investigators search for even the smallest clues, only to find what they feared in their own backyard. In Canada, two people die suddenly of unknown causes, and their deaths may not be as coincidental as they first appear.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Flames Of Justice
programme.desc: Arson fires are set for their own sake, or to cover a different crime, such as murder. Think fire consumes all vital clues? Think again. Arson investigators can glean important clues from scorched rubble and ignite the unquenchable flames of justice.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: Medical Examiners's Casebook
programme.desc: Some killers choose to hide their victims. And investigators must then rely on forensic examiners to uncover proof of murder. These are just two extraordinary crimes that have made their way into the medical examiner's casebook.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: We Can't Live Like This
programme.desc: Thornton says he can't trust his cheating girlfriend Crystal and wants her to take a lie detector test! Plus, Stephanie wants to prove to her husband Mathew that she's not having sex with her own family member! She wants the accusations put to rest.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I'm Raising Him, But Is He Mine?
programme.desc: Deshawn claims that his ex Lynette abandoned their 5-year-old son. But she claims that he is keeping her from their child. However, Deshawn recently found out that he isn't listed on his son's birth certificate, so he wants a DNA test!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: I Know About the Affair, But Is He the Father?
programme.desc: Stephanie gave birth to a baby boy and believes Brandon is the father. But Brandon claims he didn't find out about the child until three years later and denies being the father. Stephanie and her mother want Brandon to step up.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Steve Gets The Real Update
programme.desc: Megan wanted to find out if her boyfriend Devin was cheating. But even darker relationship secrets surface! Plus, you'll be shocked to find out why Laura and Steven need Steve's help again!

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Falsely Accused of Molestation?
programme.desc: Desmond believes that his ex Cassandra is making up a story about him touching their child because she's jealous of his new fiancée. And later, Tammy has been investigated for child abuse and even accused of locking her kids in a closet.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
programme.desc: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Relative
programme.desc: After a father is found shot in front of his home, Kenda uncovers a vengeful motive behind a deadly family feud.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Six Feet Under
programme.desc: Kenda finds the body of a bruised and battered young woman named Vicki Ross strangled. Kenda must sort through the endless suspicious characters in Vicki's past to find the elusive truth.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Outlaw
programme.desc: When a gunfight erupts at a local biker bar and claims the lives of two men, Lt. Joe Kenda must delve deep into the world of an infamous biker gang.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Avert Your Eyes
programme.desc: When Pamela Edwards is found shot through the heart, Lt. Joe Kenda’s first task is to shield her young daughters from the horrendous scene.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Stuck In A Coffin
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a five-alarm fire, first responders discover a lifeless body. When Kenda learns that the deadly blaze was no accident, he launches a manhunt.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Triple Murder Mystery
programme.desc: The story of the murder of three unsuspecting victims and how, despite the killer’s meticulous planning, investigators were able to identify and link him to the crime.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Good Samaritan
programme.desc: The Good Samaritan is the story of a ruthless murder and how determined police work and sophisticated forensic techniques eventually solved the case.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Nightclub Nightmare
programme.desc: The story of Laura Garza’s murder, how her killer was identified and how, two years after her disappearance, investigators got the break they needed after her body was discovered.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Body in the Field
programme.desc: The tragic story of Mary Ann Perez, and how an extensive cold case investigation utilizing DNA advancements, was finally able to solve her random and horrific murder.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Snapshot Killer
programme.desc: The story of the brutal murder of a young woman, how despite an extensive investigation the case went cold and how revolutionary forensic technology unlocked the case and revealed a twist in the tale.

programme.title: COPS: Memory Loss

programme.title: COPS: Check Please!

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sands of Crime
programme.desc: In the early hours of a morning just before Christmas, a college student was abducted from the parking lot of her apartment. Her body was found later that day; she had been sexually assaulted and shot at point-blank range.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Calculated Coincidence
programme.desc: A young woman is found dead in her apartment. With little evidence at the scene, the case turns cold — until police discover a link between their prime suspect and an unsolved murder committed six years earlier in a different state.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sworded Scheme
programme.desc: When a college student is reported missing, police believe their investigation will be like countless others. But when they discover blood spatter in her boyfriend's bedroom, they know this case is going to be different.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unmasked
programme.desc: A serial rapist is on the loose in a Texas town. No one knew where he'd strike next, but the audacity of his attacks and the escalation of violence against his victims made finding him imperative.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fashion Police
programme.desc: The victim had been stabbed more than thirty times and the crime scene was awash with her blood. Near her head, police discovered a distinctive button with strands of thread still attached.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Church Dis-service
programme.desc: A young woman attends evening church services, then disappears. When her abandoned car is found, the tank is empty and a gas can she kept in her trunk for emergencies is missing.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: DNA Dragnet
programme.desc: Digital enhancement of security camera footage shows that what appears to be a casual encounter is actually a forced abduction. When investigators suspect the crimes are not random, they fear a serial killer may be on the loose.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Murdering Cowboy
programme.desc: The sun set on the Wild West long ago, but some people refused to notice. Claude Dallas was one of them. A wily trapper, Dallas typified the rugged individualism that forged this country. He went too far when he killed two game wardens in 1981.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The World Trade Center Bombing
programme.desc: Terrorist bombings are what happen in other countries. Not here in the United States. And yet, in 1993, it happened in New York City.

programme.title: The FBI Files: John Gotti: Convicted
programme.desc: John Gotti was ambitious, powerful and ruthless. He ruled with flash and conspicuous style, playing celebrity with the media and cat and mouse with the FBI. They called John Gotti the Teflon Don. Serious charges just wouldn't stick.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The True Story of Mississippi Burning
programme.desc: Philadelphia, Mississippi, 1964. A sleepy southern town steeped in tradition finds itself targeted for invasion.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Blood Money
programme.desc: Some people murder for love. But these killers did it for the money. When greed is the motive, investigators must make every clue pay off.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Coroner's Casebook
programme.desc: A good coroner provides what's necessary to solve a crime. A bad one can spoil an otherwise rock-solid case. Cyril Wecht and Henry Lee, two of the country's most respected coroners, share their cases and insights into crime solving.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: Did You Leave My Kids to Die?
programme.desc: Russell wants to put his family back together after his three children died in a fire. Next, Tatiana believes her 2-year-old nephew was abused. And she's accusing her sister's ex-fiancé Chris. Chris says he's not an abuser.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: 13-Year-Old Father?
programme.desc: Curtis sat down with his mother Telisha, and told her that he is trying to have a baby but Telisha was shocked and terrified because Curtis is only 13 years old! Curtis insists he is ready to be a father.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: If I Don't Hit Her, She Doesn't Listen
programme.desc: Kelsey says her husband is abusing her. Malcolm believes that Kelsey has been cheating on him since the beginning and that their two kids may belong to another man. Plus, Carrie's boyfriend Chris thinks their child belongs to her ex.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: You Violated Me!
programme.desc: Monique wants to prove that Chris attacked her when he gave her a ride home after a party. But Chris denies any wrongdoing, and says Monique was too drunk to know what happened.

programme.title: The Steve Wilkos Show: She Said She'd Drown the Baby
programme.desc: Devon slipped into a coma and is on life support. But before he fell into a coma, he told his mother that his ex Alisha said he did not father their son. Alisha denies ever saying this and feels his whole family has turned their backs on her.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheaters Come Clean
programme.desc: Couples reveal they have been cheating on today's Jerry Springer Show. Candice confronts Nikki for sleeping with her man and Mike suspects Moon has been cheating with two people.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Stuck In A Coffin
programme.desc: In the aftermath of a five-alarm fire, first responders discover a lifeless body. When Kenda learns that the deadly blaze was no accident, he launches a manhunt.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Door No. 12
programme.desc: Neighbors are stunned when close friends Louis Matos and Colleen Johnson are gunned down for no apparent reason. The case kicks into high gear when Lt Joe Kenda locates a panic-stricken eyewitness.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Snitch
programme.desc: When officers respond to a shooting , they discover the body of a young man they know all to well -- police informant Jimmie Stevenson. it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine who pulled the trigger.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Slaughterhouse Six
programme.desc: Solider and young father Layne Schmidtke is brutally beaten to death by a mob of teenagers. Kenda must reconstruct the chaotic scene through forensic evidence and witness testimonies.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sacrificial Lamb
programme.desc: When 13yr old PJ Grant is found dead from a single gunshot wound to the head, Kenda assumes it’s a suicide. When the physical evidence doesn’t add up, it opens the door to a world of possibilities.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead On Target
programme.desc: A young father-to-be is shot dead in broad daylight by a single bullet fired from afar. At the crime scene, Kenda recognizes the hallmark of a skilled sniper.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Snapshot Killer
programme.desc: The story of the brutal murder of a young woman, how despite an extensive investigation the case went cold and how revolutionary forensic technology unlocked the case and revealed a twist in the tale.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Schenectady Strangler
programme.desc: The Schenectady Strangler is the story of the tragic murder of Brett Wentworth, how police tracked his killer down and how advanced forensic technology was the key to solving the case.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Small Town Slayer
programme.desc: The tragic story of the murder of Brenda Dupont and how after 28 years, the officers involved were determined to bring the perpetrator to justice using advanced forensic techniques.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Nightmare Neighbors
programme.desc: The story of the senseless and cruel murder of Denise O’Neill. The program unveils the comprehensive forensics and shrewd detective work involved in bringing her killers to justice.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Almost Free
programme.desc: The murder of Maggie Locascio, the complex investigation into her death, and how relentless detective work, along with extensive forensics captured the perpetrators and brought them to justice.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Agent of Death
programme.desc: The story of the violent murder of Dr John Yelenic and how the investigation into his death became one of the most infamous and shocking in Pennsylvania state history.

programme.title: SvampBob Fyrkant
programme.desc: SvampBob Fyrkant helt egna kanal! Här följer du historien om Svampbob och hans vattenvänners upptåg och äventyr i undervattensbyn Bikini Botten.

programme.title: SvampBob Fyrkant
programme.desc: SvampBob Fyrkant helt egna kanal! Här följer du historien om Svampbob och hans vattenvänners upptåg och äventyr i undervattensbyn Bikini Botten.

programme.title: SvampBob Fyrkant
programme.desc: SvampBob Fyrkant helt egna kanal! Här följer du historien om Svampbob och hans vattenvänners upptåg och äventyr i undervattensbyn Bikini Botten.

programme.title: iCarly: Matfajten
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie besegrar en berömd TV-kock i en matlagningstävling, slutar kocken laga mat, lägger ned sitt matlagningsprogram och vägrar komma ut ur sitt sovrum. Spencer försöker få sin framtidsvision att bli verklighet.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag vill ha min rektor
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie av misstag får rektor Franklin avskedad, tar fröken Briggs och magister Howard kontrollen och inför hårda regler. Under tiden anställer Spencer en gammal rodeostjärna som ska lära honom hur man rider på en mekanisk tjur.

programme.title: iCarly: Snabbdejt
programme.desc: Det kommer så många killar till "Gå ut och dansa med Carly"-tävlingen att Carly, Sam och Freddie måste ha snabb-dejter för att hinna träffa dem alla. Spencer följer ett bisarrt träningsprogram från en ny Pearphone-app.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag fixar till en popstjärna
programme.desc: När Carly, Sam och Freddie går med på att göra en musikvideo inför en popstjärnas comeback, upptäcker de att popstjärnan är ur form och saknar talang. Under tiden upptäcker Spencer att kvinnan han dejtar är Gibbys mamma.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag räddade ditt liv
programme.desc: När Freddie räddar Carlys liv, blir Carly kär i honom. Under tiden tävlar Sam och Spencer mot varandra i ett paintballspel som heter Assassin.

programme.title: iCarly: iHittar Lewberts förlorade kärlek
programme.desc: När gänget upptäcker att Lewbert en gång var en lycklig ung man som var förlovad med en vacker kvinna, bestämmer de sig för att återförena de två älskande.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag var en tävlingstjej
programme.desc: Sam avslöjar för Carly och Freddie att hon tävlade i skönhetstävlingar när hon var liten. När hon får veta att hennes gamla rival ska tävla i Seattle övertalar hon Carly att ställa upp mot henne.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag ställer inte in showen
programme.desc: Efter att Sam plötsligt åkt i fängelse, lovar Carly och Freddie dyrt och heligt att inte ställa in webbshowen eftersom hennes pappa ska titta på den. Så Carly ber Spencer hjälpa till, vilket visar sig bli svårt eftersom han har en dejt samma kväll.

programme.title: iCarly: Ute i rymden
programme.desc: En excentrisk miljardär ber Carly och hennes vänner att sända den första webbshowen från yttre rymden, så de får genomgå tester inför rymdresan. Under tiden besöker en underlig liten flicka Spencer hemma i våningen.

programme.title: iCarly: Jag flyttar hemifrån
programme.desc: Freddie bestämmer sig för att flytta hemifrån efter att hans mamma har skämt ut honom; Carly, Sam och Freddie startar ett företag som specialiserar sig på att fotografera husdjur.

programme.title: iCarly: iBeat The Heat
programme.desc: När värmeböljan slår Seattle och elen försvinner kommer Spencer till räddning med sin norska luftkondition.

programme.desc: Kommer detektiverna hitta NBA-historiens mest kända boll och lösa mysteriet med en tvivelaktig Kentucky Derby-trofé?

programme.title: Amerika i färg: 1960-talet
programme.desc: Besök Amerika under det turbulenta 60-talet, när gryningen i det moderna Amerika ges färg med hjälp av digital teknik.

programme.title: Mystikens Storbritannien: Sökandet efter Kung Arthur
programme.desc: Han är Storbritanniens mest legendariska konung... men existerade han verkligen?

programme.title: Loose at the Zoo
programme.desc: En nära titt på några brasilianska apor, bland annat gyllenhuvade lejontamariner, på National Zoo i Washington, D.C.

programme.title: CBS News Mornings
programme.desc: CBS News Mornings broadcasts on weekdays and offers viewers up-to-date news, comprehensive weather forecasts, and highlights from the world of sports.

programme.title: CBS Morning News
programme.desc: CBS News Mornings is a live daily morning news show that is anchored by Anne-Marie Green. Get ahead on the latest news by streaming the most important national and global stories first thing in the morning.

programme.title: CBS Mornings
programme.desc: Reporting on international news stories, interviews, and in-depth pieces, covering topics from news, sports, climate and technology to race, health, parenting and personal finance.

programme.title: CBS News 24/7 Mornings
programme.desc: Se på CBS News, dygnet runt och följ de senaste världstäckande nyheterna med spännade reportage och heta diskussioner.

programme.title: Art of the Heist: The Big Sting
programme.desc: On December 22nd, 2000 three of the world's greatest art treasures were stolen from the National Museum in Stockholm. Together the Rembrandt and two Renoir paintings were valued at 50 million dollars.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Metropolitan Museum, New York
programme.desc: From the mystery of a king’s madness to a silver chalice some think is the Holy Grail, discover the secrets inside the Metropolitan Museum.

programme.title: Museum Secrets: Inside the Bardo Museum, Tunisia
programme.desc: From the real lives of gladiators to the connection between Star Wars and Tunisia, discover the secrets inside the Bardo Museum.

programme.title: Ancient Black Ops: The Viking Berserkers
programme.desc: Striking terror into the heart of peace-loving Christians across medieval Europe, the Viking Berserkers are vicious, pagan-worshipping fanatics, rumoured to have taken magic mushrooms and turned themselves into wild animals.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Mind of the Universe: The Creator
programme.desc: Creating is a deed that captivates minds. Today, we are better creators than ever before. We will see how we can play with conditions for creating life, make anything we can think of with the code of life itself, and replace parts of our body.

programme.title: On the Case: Courage and Conviction
programme.desc: A college student's battle for survival may be the key to solving a double homicide from years earlier.

programme.title: On the Case: Campus Killer
programme.desc: When a young girl goes missing from her university campus, her mother is forced to lead an investigation for the truth. Can she find her precious daughter before it's too late?

programme.title: On the Case: A Long Journey To Justice
programme.desc: When a young college student is found murdered on the side of road, it is the start of a tormenting 26 year journey to justice for her family.

programme.title: On the Case: Betrayal and Regret
programme.desc: After a teenage girl is found murdered in an isolated cemetery, police must untangle a dark mystery in order to bring her killer to justice.

programme.title: On the Case: A Face with No Name
programme.desc: Police have DNA evidence and a videotape of their suspect, yet they still struggle to find a vicious killer.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Air Show
programme.desc: Joe flies with the Snowbirds during the Hamilton air show and later teaches Mikey to fly. A surprise departure shakes up Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Five Seasons
programme.desc: Ice Pilots NWT celebrates a milestone with a look back at the last five years, a peek behind the camera and reflections from the Buffalo crew.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: A Ball O'Snags
programme.desc: An engine fire and series of mechanical gremlins has Buffalo scrambling to make its Christmas deliveries. Newest rampie Prefkar Mony struggles with life in the North.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Ice Storm
programme.desc: Buffalo's Electra aircraft is hammered by rough winds up the Mackenzie Valley. In Hay River, a rookie crew faces the worst ice storm in years and one rampie has a tough go trying to fit in at Buffalo.

programme.title: Ice Pilots NWT: Old Dogs
programme.desc: Engine trouble plagues Buffalo's newest Electra, ZFE, and a standoff between Joe and Transport Canada threatens to close the airline. At the same time, Joe faces a tough decision about his old dog Sophie.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Pilar Valdes, Drew's News
programme.desc: Drew and Ross Mathewsare covering the news including headlines like the study that found mammals who have friends live longer and the ice cream shop in D.C. serving everyone, even those who can't pay! Pilar Valdesis back with a new Pro Tips with Pilar.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Tig Notaro, Drew's News
programme.desc: "Your Place or Mine" star Tig Notaro is telling Drew about working with Reese Witherspoon on their new film and the latest season of "The Morning Show."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew's Birthday Surprise Show with Penn Badgley& John Oliver
programme.desc: It's Drew's birthday and we're celebrating all show long with some special surprises for her! "You" star Penn Badgley is surprising Drew with a special birthday present and telling her all about the new season of his hit show.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Pilar Valdes, Danny Seo, Mikel Welch, Drew's News with Rachel Dratch
programme.desc: The celebration continues, and Drew's birthday twin Rachel Dratch has a delicious surprise for her when she joinsDrew and Ross Mathews at the Drew's News desk.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: William Jackson Harper, Drew's News, Andrew Rea
programme.desc: "Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania" star William Jackson Harper is telling Drew about his role in the new Marvel film, why he took his dog to a pet psychic and how he met his girlfriend.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Bronwyn Tarboton, Drew's News
programme.desc: Bronwyn Tarboton is sharing some genius upcycling tips including how to create home décor out of items in your trash.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Guy Fieri, Damona Hoffman, Pilar Valdes, Robin Black
programme.desc: "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives" host Guy Fieri is joining Drew to chat and play a game! Dating expert Damona Hoffman is joining Drew, Ross Mathews and his husband Wellington Garciato talk about love and soulmates.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew's News with Taye Diggs, Jamila Norman, Jeralyn Gerba, Nadine Jane
programme.desc: "All American" star Taye Diggs is joining Drew and Ross Mathews at the news desk to hit the hottest headlines of the day! Jamila Norman is joining Drew and Taye and sharing tips on how to build your own herb garden.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Senator Bernie Sanders, Drew's News
programme.desc: Senator Bernie Sanders is joining Drew to chat about his new book. He's also joining Drew and Ross Mathews at the Drew's News desk to discuss local Vermont headlines and share some of his favorite Vermont-based small businesses.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Jabari Banks, Drew's News
programme.desc: "Bel-Air" star Jabari Banks is joining Drew to chat about his show. Drew and her co-pilot Ross Mathews are serving the news sunny-side up in an all-new Drew's News.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show: Drew's News with Gayle King, Drew & Ross Visit Montana
programme.desc: "CBS Mornings" co-host Gayle King is joining Drew and Ross Mathews to hit the headlines, covering topics like the woman who found an unusual way to calm her nerves before a first kiss.

programme.title: 48 Hours
programme.desc: In 1994, 25-year-old Toni Dykstra of Los Angeles, the single mother of two young daughters, met and married Carlo Ventre, a successful 46-year-old Italian businessman. After Toni gave birth to their child, Santina, the couple's relationship soured.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Secrets From The Grave
programme.desc: Bill Flint spent his life cheating death -- not once, not twice, but three times. His friends say this is a story of how a lot of bad things happened to a really good person.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Black Dahlia Confidential
programme.desc: The brutal murder in 1947 of Elizabeth Short, a young, struggling actress whose body was discovered in a vacant lot in January 1947, has baffled the Los Angeles Police Department for decades

programme.title: 48 Hours: Blaming the Babysitter
programme.desc: A frantic 13-year-old, Ashley Howes, calls 911 because the toddler she's babysitting won't wake up. Prosecutors are convinced Ashley Howes shook 19-month-old Freya Garden to death. They charge Howes with second degree murder.

programme.title: 48 Hours: The Informer
programme.desc: A report on the moral dilemma faced by Jim Morel, a Massachusetts musician, who was told by another musician friend, Jason Weir, that the 2001 death of Marina Calabro, the aunt of their bandmate Anthony Calabro, though ruled an accident, was murder.

programme.title: COPS: Check Please!
programme.desc: Deputies confront an intoxicated man who threatened a restaurant owner. A man tells officers he can assault who he wants. Officers are called to an altercation over a sleeping bag and a backpack.

programme.title: COPS: Decorating Tips
programme.desc: Officers pursue an SUV on the freeway. Deputies are called when an agitated man armed with scissors tears up a trailer. A driver tells officers the illegal items found in his car was left by a friend.

programme.title: COPS: Hide and Go Porch
programme.desc: Officers engage in a car chase when they spot a possible robbery suspect. A man nicknamed "Danger" is tasered after assaulting several girls. Suspects bail from a vehicle and hide under a porch.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A prostitution sting leads police to uncover additional crimes . A prostitute tells deputies she wanted money to buy her daughter a birthday gift. Deputies are called to an assault at a pub.

programme.title: COPS: Alleycat
programme.desc: Officers search for a runaway suspect with a weapons charge. A man admits to having a large number of drugs during a traffic stop. Officers respond to a man with a gun in an alley.

programme.title: COPS: Victoria's New Secret
programme.desc: Deputies observe a woman stuff drugs into her bra. A mother attacks her daughter because she got married in Vegas. Officers are called when a woman is accused of stalking her friend.

programme.title: COPS: Apologies Detective
programme.desc: Officers hold a man under a car at gunpoint after a traffic stop. Officers are flagged down and directed to an arguing couple. A man apologizes to detectives for the illicit items they find.

programme.title: COPS: It's Laundry Day
programme.desc: Deputies detain a man when a gun falls from his pantleg. Deputies are called when a father spits on his son's girlfriend. Officers respond when a child is bitten by two large dogs.

programme.title: COPS: Nothing Upstairs
programme.desc: Officers pursue a motorcyclist driving erratically. Deputies find broken drug paraphernalia in a car when conducting a traffic stop. A man who beat up his girlfriend hides from officers in an attic.

programme.title: COPS: Follow Me to the River
programme.desc: A deputy jumps into a waterway to arrest a fleeing suspect. Officers respond to roommates in an argument. Officers are called when two crossdressers attack a group of women.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Two Accused of Murder (Jennifer Charron Case)
programme.desc: On Sunday, April 29, 2007, the body of Jennifer Charron, 21-years old, was found burnt to a crisp in a forest near Royan. The young waitress, who had been missing for two days, was visibly beaten and tied up.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Josiane Bézard Case
programme.desc: On the morning of January 9th 2014, Josiane Bézard, 53 years old, drives her son to the Manosque's train station, and then vanishes.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deadly Trap in the Forest - Christophe Belle
programme.desc: On March 19th 1998, Akira Ojima, a 57 years old japanese architect, is found dead in the fridge of a villa in Nanterre.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: I början av 90-talet skakas Norge av flera mordbränder. 1993 hittades Øystein Aarseth död i ett trapphus i Oslo. Polisen riktar in sig på personer inom black metal-kulturen. En av de är Varg Vikernes.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 505
programme.desc: Innan jul år 2000 utsätts Nationalmuseum för landets största konstkupp någonsin. Konstverk till ett värde av 370 miljoner kronor, försvinner. Nu måste polisen använda udda metoder för att lösa fallet.

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 101
programme.desc: Anne Elisabeth Hagen försvinner spårlöst från sitt hem hösten 2018. Hennes man, miljardären Tom Hagen, hittar ett brev i huset med krav på en lösensumma.

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 303
programme.desc: En 21-årig teaterstudent kliver ur en bil i södra Tyskland och hävdar för tysk polis att han kidnappats och sedan tvingats mörda sin vän och hyresvärd. Men är hans version av historien verkligen sann? (Del 2)

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 701

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2909

programme.title: Lyxfällan: Avsnitt 2303

programme.title: Lyxfällan
programme.desc: För 25 år sen investerade Katarina i en syaffär. Affären gick dessvärre i konkurs och kvar stod hon med en skuld på över 500 tusen kronor. Katarina har nu som sista utväg vänt sig till Lyxfällan.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Smiley Face
programme.desc: The woman had been sexually assaulted, stabbed repeatedly and left for dead. When a perfect suspect practically turned himself in, police were sure they had their man until DNA evidence proved them wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dirty Laundry
programme.desc: The victim was a self-made man who never minced words. Perhaps he was murdered by a disgruntled client or employee. Perhaps the racy photos in his safe held the clue to solving the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: As Fault
programme.desc: Witnesses saw a woman in the back of a truck, flailing her arms and screaming. When they found a jacket near a pool of blood, they knew what they had seen wasn't a joy ride.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Family Ties
programme.desc: When court clerk Peter Porco doesn't report to work in November 2004, a courts officer is ordered to the Porcos' family home in Bethlehem, NY.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Trouble Brewing
programme.desc: Two suspects are linked to a murder by bloodstained boots and a gun, but the owner of the items says he has never met the victim. Investigators hope manufacturing codes from beer bottles will determine who is telling the truth.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Holy Terror
programme.desc: This episode documents a deadly bombing at a church in Oakwood, Illinois, in December 1997.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Room with a View
programme.desc: A young woman is stabbed more than 100 times. The killer leaves DNA behind, but investigators must play a cat-and-mouse game to obtain a suspect's DNA to match.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dollars and Sense
programme.desc: On Christmas Eve 2005, a man's body is found burning near Baltimore. He's eventually identified as 26-year-old Wesley Person. Distinctive building materials from the 1930s play a crucial role in solving this case.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Polly Klaas: Kidnapped
programme.desc: On October 1, 1993, a stranger abducted 12-year-old Polly Klaas during a slumber party in her home.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Human Prey
programme.desc: Thomas Dillon killed five outdoorsmen at random over a period of three years in rural southern Ohio. After a tip led the FBI to the murder weapon, ballistic testing made a match.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Death in Alaska
programme.desc: The day began like any other for Cheryl and Paul Chapman, until the silence of a peaceful Sunday morning was shattered with a phone call.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Absent Witness
programme.desc: When killers hide or destroy the remains of their victims, it becomes the mission of forensic scientists to reconstruct the scenes and prove murder for an absent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead Men Do Talk
programme.desc: Profiles the work of world-renowned forensic experts and the procedures they use to solve murders and other mysteries in minutes or centuries after they happen.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Web of Clues
programme.desc: Forensic Entomology: Bugs have roamed the earth for 250 million years, but their intimate association with death is just now coming to life.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fateful Twist
programme.desc: A southeastern Virginia community is stunned by a crime no one can believe. A pregnant woman murdered, her baby lost. Across the state, another town feels a similar shock, a brutal, random slaying in a most unexpected setting.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheaters Come Clean

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Holiday Hell Feast
programme.desc: Melody is horrified that her sister, Amanda, is ruining her life by dating a 54 year old biker and loser named Wolf. Today they'll face off against Amanda's entire family!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Homewreckers Confronted
programme.desc: Linda says her former best friend is trying to steal her man and she's fighting back! Then, Sherry wants her boyfriend Terry's wife Sandy and her family out of their lives!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wives Battle Mistresses
programme.desc: Today, Vicki will face her husband Jason and his lover with an ultimatum and Anna admits she’s trying to steal Misty’s husband – again!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: We Live In A Car
programme.desc: Our guests say they're ready to come clean. Yolando regrets sleeping with her best friend’s boyfriend and Cameron has been hiding a secret from his roommates.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: High Class Call Girls
programme.desc: Bambi gives us a rare, honest look into her ultra-exclusive lifestyle in LA. Tiffany confronts C.T. over a rotten business deal.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Holiday Hell With My Feuding Family

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Dead On Target

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Standoff
programme.desc: A disabled man is killed on the job, but Kenda’s case hits a roadblock when forensic evidence is scrubbed from the scene.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Trust No One
programme.desc: When martial arts enthusiast Carl Hunt suffers a fatal knife wound to the gut, his friends and neighbors offer few viable leads. But Kenda discovers blood evidence that proves he’s being lied to.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Innocence
programme.desc: War hero Carl Taylor is beaten to death in the back of an empty semi truck, for no apparent reason. Lt Joe Kenda notices an unusual pattern in the victim’s head wounds.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Agent of Death

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Bike Path Rapist
programme.desc: The story of how a man who terrorized an entire county, was brought to justice and how the case led to the exoneration of an innocent man, jailed for 22 years for crimes he didn’t commit.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Devil Disguised
programme.desc: The story of a truly virtuous young victim and how a relentless police and forensics investigation ensured her killer, a true devil on earth, would never escape justice again….

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Shoe Fetish Killer
programme.desc: The compellingly tragic story of a random attack by a perverted killer, and how smart police work and a detailed forensic investigation ultimately led to the person responsible.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Erie County Killer
programme.desc: The investigation into Joan Giambra’s murder, how it became linked to a string of other murders and how the miracle of DNA technology and the persistence of a committed detective solved the crime.

programme.title: 48 Hours: Duty, Death, Dishonor

programme.title: 48 Hours: Deadly Ride

programme.title: 48 Hours: Nightmare in Napa

programme.title: 48 Hours: Jeffrey MacDonald: Fight for Truth
programme.desc: A report on the 1970 murders of U.S. Army Doctor Jeffrey MacDonald’s pregnant wife and two daughters at their Fort Bragg home. Having served 25 years in prison for the murders, MacDonald still proclaims his innocence.

programme.title: COPS: Follow Me to the River

programme.title: COPS: Last Call Brawl

programme.title: COPS: He's the Gingerbread Man

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A jaywalker with no id bolts away from an officer. A man mixes illicit items with his pizza. A woman involved in a domestic violence call blames her monthly issues.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A combative man at a fast food restaurant claims his phone was stolen. Multiple illegal items are found on a man parked on the side of the road. An intoxicated man throws an 83-year-old's walker.

programme.title: COPS
programme.desc: A homeless man hides from deputies in the closet of an empty house. Deputies arrive to a domestic disturbance to find two brothers fighting over a pair of sandals.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: (Ruth Légeret Case) Bloody Christmas next to the Leman lake
programme.desc: On January 4, 2006, Ruth Légeret was found dead in the middle of a pool of blood at her luxurious property in Vevey, Switzerland. Next to her was the lifeless body of her friend, Marina Studer. Who could have killed these two simple and wealthy widows?

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Mathilde Croguenne Case

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot In the While Sleeping (Richard Alessandri Case)

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Murdered For a Fake Treasure - Troadec Case

programme.title: Norska Fall: Avsnitt 202

programme.title: Svenska fall: Avsnitt 1303

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hair Line
programme.desc: Doctors don't know why a young scientist has fallen gravely ill. When tests finally reveal the cause, it's too late to save him.

programme.title: Forensic Files: All that Glitters is Gold
programme.desc: Police discover a bullet-riddled car, a missing driver and no witnesses. Had the victim been abducted or was she dead? The answers are found in a unique clue, so tiny it was measured in millionths of a meter.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Sign of the Crime
programme.desc: In little more than a month, two women who lived in the same apartment complex were brutally murdered. The similarities of the crime scenes led police to conclude they were dealing with a serial killer who harbored an intense hatred of women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Covet Thy Neighbour
programme.desc: When a college student vanished without a trace, her fellow students were concerned about her safety and their own.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writing on the Wall
programme.desc: The victim was well liked and successful, which made the brutality of the crime even harder to understand.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hundreds of Reasons
programme.desc: An assistant manager of a Florida steakhouse is stabbed to death. It appears to be a robbery gone wrong, but a bloody fingerprint reveals that he knew his killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cold Feet
programme.desc: In 1985, Julie Estes was kidnapped from the Southside convenience store where she worked. Her body was found the next day, but the killing went unsolved until 2003.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Separation Anxiety
programme.desc: Tracey Frame, 35, was convicted of killing David Nixon in April 2002 after he planned to end their relationship.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Office Visit
programme.desc: A surgeon is stabbed to death and the most likely suspect is seen in a restaurant at the time of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Palm Saturday
programme.desc: At the scene of a vicious murder, the killer went to a great deal of effort to wipe away his fingerprints and obscure his shoe impressions left when he tracked blood trails on the floor.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Paradise
programme.desc: It should have been Shangri-La, but when bad blood developed, piracy took over and the only law was the law of the jungle.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Killing Spree
programme.desc: In 1984, in South Florida, a rapist and murderer was on the loose. The killer was a ruthless and terrifying predator, the newest member of an infamous group known as serial killers.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Melissa Brannen: Missing
programme.desc: In 1989, residents of a close-knit apartment community in Virginia gathered for a holiday celebration. For Tammy Brannen and five-year-old daughter Melissa, Christmas was always a special time. Then without warning, the little girl was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Unabomber
programme.desc: For nearly two decades a mathematical genius with delusions of single-handedly destroying industrial society, planted or mailed powerful bombs to unsuspecting innocent victims.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Marked For Death
programme.desc: Sometimes killers are careful to leave no fingerprints behind. But methods of the murder itself can leave a lasting impression on police, especially when the tools (or weapons) of a killer's trade leave an innocent victim marked for death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Trails of Evidence
programme.desc: In criminal investigations, a simple clue can provide the missing link by placing a suspect at a crime scene. Dirt left on shoes, tires or clothes, or even a tiny piece of plastic can pinpoint a crime scene.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Remnant of Blame
programme.desc: The solution to the most heinous crimes often hinge on the smallest of clues. Investigators must have their eyes trained to find the full story of a murder written in a single scrap of evidence.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Family Plots
programme.desc: Every family has its secrets, and sometimes blood relations lead to bloodshed. When murder becomes a family affair, investigators must turn to forensics to uncover family plots.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Holiday Hell With My Feuding Family
programme.desc: There’s no worse time to be fighting with your family than during the holidays. Our old friends Donna and her cheating husband Richard join us for a holiday feast!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Cheating Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Chris and Steve confess to cheating on their girlfriends and Michelle wants to tell her boyfriend she has a mistress. The tension is high on today's Jerry Springer Show!

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: My Pimp Runs My Family
programme.desc: Tracy and Allen have been living in a car. Her two older sisters are here to convince her to temporarily live with them and go back to school until he can provide for them.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I'm Marrying a Transsexual!
programme.desc: Jerry is 58 years old and has had three big changes. He is currently happily engaged to a woman named Joy and speaks about his past gender confusion.

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: I Have Many Lovers
programme.desc: Today, Rufus comes clean about cheating on Treynae with Cheeta and Rhonda tells her girlfriend Lovette that she's in an affair with another woman! Who will choose whom?

programme.title: The Jerry Springer Show: Wife Discovers Husband's Secret Family
programme.desc: Ron left Stacie when she was 8 months pregnant with his child for Audrey and thought he'd found his soul mate. Are Stacie's kids all his? Watch this classic showdown today!

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood On the Tracks
programme.desc: When an unsuspecting train conductor discovers a decapitated body on a lonely stretch of track, Lt. Joe Kenda must unravel the mystery of his death.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Eye of the Beholder
programme.desc: Kenda encounters one of the most horrendous crime scenes of his career, but his hunt for a homicidal maniac leads him to the most unexpected of killers.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Sex, Lies, and Surveillance Tape
programme.desc: A confrontation between enemies turns deadly, and Lt. Joe Kenda’s best hope for answers lies with a grainy, dubbed-over surveillance tape.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Bad Blood
programme.desc: An army vet is found bleeding to death on the asphalt of a parking lot -- his chest littered with too many knife wounds to count. Kenda’s case is stuck in first gear until a gruesome clue appears.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Rearview Mirror
programme.desc: When a retired military man runs over a pedestrian, it’s up to Lt. Joe Kenda to determine if it was bad brakes or bad intent.

programme.title: Homicide Hunter: Blood Sisters
programme.desc: The bullet-ridden bodies of two sisters are found in a suburban house that’s littered with mysterious clues. Joe Kenda learns that the two unassuming young mothers shared an explosive secret.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Erie County Killer
programme.desc: The investigation into Joan Giambra’s murder, how it became linked to a string of other murders and how the miracle of DNA technology and the persistence of a committed detective solved the crime.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Murder of Beverly Ann Dyke
programme.desc: Police investigated a brutal and senseless murder, and false claims of guilt nearly derailed the investigation but the victim’s family never gave up trying to find the truth and uncover the killer.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Veiled Killer
programme.desc: The inquiry into the death of David Castor and how an extensive police investigation, fueled with the power of forensics, uncovered another victim and brought the perpetrator to justice.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Whelan Family Murders
programme.desc: Sharon Whelan and her daughters were attacked and killed in their home on Christmas Eve. A multi-discipline forensics investigation uncovered the killer’s horrific actions and brought him to justice.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: The Murder of Imette St. Guillen
programme.desc: The events leading up to a horrific murder, the large-scale police investigation that identified the killer and how the powerful strands of forensics were able to link the killer to other victims.

programme.title: Trace of Evil: Murder in The Mountains
programme.desc: The story of the brutal death of Phyllis Murphy, how her family never thought they’d see justice, and how after almost two decades, modern forensic technology eventually led police to her murderer.
